name: Every rendered first-page Deal field matches the all-deals API
description:
Objective: Every required rendered Deal field matches its all-deals response item.
Preconditions: QA has existing deals.
Steps:
1. Open Deals.
2. Capture the page-size-10 response.
3. Compare identities business merchant broker type amounts dates remaining percentage and status.
Expected: Every required table value matches the corresponding API item exactly.
